prefs.how: tools/learn_prefs.py: conditional logit on top drafters' head-to-head picks, weighted by event wins + 1, test drafts excluded

branch.how: tools/fit_branch.py FRA --winners: when winning top drafters switch to the stronger card

branch_colour.how: tools/fit_branch.py FRA --winners --full: when top drafters switch to the stronger card

closecalls.how: tools/close_calls.py: how often top drafters (train sample) take v2's #1/#2/#3 by gap

deckmodel.how: tools/deck_model.py fit: regularised logistic of game wins on 17Lands public game data

decks.how: tools/deck_targets.py: mean deck of 60%+ players per two-colour pair and three-colour combination (>= 150 decks), from 17Lands game data

splash.how: tools/fit_splash.py: when 60%+ players splash (17Lands game data), logistic on edge, fixing, playables, above, duals, depth, removal, cmc

offcolour.how: tools/fit_offcolour.py: share of cards outside 60%+ players' core pair that made their deck, logistic on GIH WR z and 2+ off pips

three.how: tools/fit_splash.py: when 60%+ players play three main colours (17Lands game data), logistic on adds, fixing, playables, duals, depth

synergy.how: tools/fit_themes.py: manual.json themes tested as enablers x payoffs terms in the deck model, held-out games

pairs.how: tools/fit_pairs.py: low-rank card-pair interactions on top of the deck model, 17Lands game data

choices.how: tools/choice_model.py fit: conditional logit of top drafters' picks on v2's score plus synergy, deck needs, colour, mana value

blend.how: tools/choice_model.py blend: conditional logit of top drafters' picks per pick (with its neighbours) on Power, Fit, signal, wheel, synergy, needs

card_needs.how: tools/card_needs.py: manual.json card_wants tested on 17Lands game data (enablers x card in hand, controlling for deck quality, skill, play/draw)

three_draft.how: tools/fit_three_draft.py: from pack 2, whether 60%+ drafters end in the pool's core pair plus the best third colour, 2575 drafts (salt three, train/test left out)

deckmodel_top3.how: tools/deck_model.py fit: regularised logistic of game wins on 17Lands public game data, 60%+ players' games weighted x3.0

card_pairs.how: tools/card_pairs.py: setup cards' pairs within 1.5 GIH WR points of their best (>= 150 games in hand)

within_deck.how: tools/within_deck.py: within-deck synergy, 20 placebo sets, 200 deck bootstraps

structure.how: tools/deck_shapes.py: min/best/max (p10/median/p90) of 60%+ players' decks per colour combination; replacements = categories they run >= 0.5 more of when one is 2+ under

strategy.how: analysis/strategy_win_loss.py: Premier drafts with one deck for the whole run, binomial match wins ~ enablers + payoffs + skill + q; match-WR points per extra card (descriptive; only ping_enabler clears zero at p<0.001)

strategy_plan.how: analysis/strategy_plan.py: median enablers / payoffs / top payoffs in one-deck Premier trophy decks per pair, with the pair's plan from docs/archetypes-FRA.md

removal_skip.how: tools/removal_skip.py: mean count of the listed removal cards in 60%+ players' decks per pair

splash_lands.how: tools/fit_splash.py --lands-only: the splash rule's inputs (edge, fixing, playables, above, duals, depth, removal, cmc) with fixing from lands only (deckbuilder.SPLASH_RULE_LANDS_ONLY reads this section)

deckmodel_v2.how: tools/deck_model.py fit2 (version 2 shape: true nonbasic lands, 2+ splash colours, splash sources, main duals, skill dummy per 0.02 bucket)

deckmodel_top3_v2.how: tools/deck_model.py fit2 (version 2 shape: true nonbasic lands, 2+ splash colours, splash sources, main duals, skill dummy per 0.02 bucket), 60%+ players' games weighted x3

branch.model: P(take Power) = sigmoid(a + b*gap + c*c_strength), c_strength = power(C) - format mean

branch_colour.model: P(take Power) = sigmoid(a + b*gap + c*c_strength + d*keeps_colour + e*settled), c_strength = power(C) - format mean

synergy.method: offset: deck model fitted once, each theme fitted alone on its linear predictor; SE from 20 draft-cluster bootstraps
